question: Which goddesses protect the practitioner on the right side?
premises: Śrī Mahābhairavī is invoked for protection.
Protection is requested on the right side.
inference: Ḍākinī and Śrī Mahābhairavī protect me on the right side.
plain_english: May Ḍākinī protect me on the right, and may Śrī Mahābhairavī protect me.
